name: Guardian's Locket
description: Every party member starts each battle with 4 Block.
flavor: Two halves of one locket, one for each sister.

name: Scholar's Satchel
description: Draw 1 extra card on the first turn of each battle.
flavor: Still smells of the castle library.

name: Healer's Pendant
description: After each won battle, every living party member heals 5 HP.
flavor: A gift from the palace infirmary.

name: Sundial Shard
description: Every 3rd turn, gain 1 Energy.
flavor: Its shadow points at the third hour, always.

name: Thorn Pouch
description: At the start of each battle, apply 2 Bleed to ALL enemies.
flavor: Caltrops of black thorn, scattered before the first blow.

effects.text: At the start of each battle, apply 2 Bleed to ALL enemies.

name: Royal Pear
description: Both sisters gain 6 Max HP.
flavor: From the queen's own orchard.

name: Whispering Bell
description: The 3rd card the party plays each turn gives both sisters 3 Block.
flavor: It rings only when the rhythm is right.

effects.text: The 3rd card the party plays each turn gives both sisters 3 Block.

name: Raven Horn
description: When an enemy falls, gain 1 Energy (twice per turn).
flavor: Ravens gather where a foe falls.

effects.text: When an enemy falls, gain 1 Energy (twice per turn).

name: Sisters' Locket
description: When a card follows one of the other sister's, both sisters gain 2 Block (3 times per turn).
flavor: Twin portraits that turn to face each other.

effects.text: When a card follows one of the other sister's, both sisters gain 2 Block (3 times per turn).

name: Chime of Echoes
description: The 4th card the party plays each turn deals 4 damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: Every fourth note shatters something.

effects.text: The 4th card the party plays each turn deals 4 damage to ALL enemies.

name: Ley Crystal
description: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Aether.
flavor: A splinter of the ley lines under the castle.

name: Mercury Bell
description: At the start of each turn, deal 2 damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: Its toll stings the ears of the wicked.

effects.text: The first Attack the party plays each turn draws 1 card.

name: Tidal Mirror
description: When Block stops a whole enemy attack, draw 1 card (twice per turn).
flavor: It shows the blow before it lands.

effects.text: When Block stops a whole enemy attack, draw 1 card (twice per turn).

name: Alchemist's Stone
description: The first time a sister applies a debuff each turn, it gets 1 extra stack.
flavor: Whatever touches it grows a little worse.

effects.text: The first time a sister applies a debuff each turn, it gets 1 extra stack.

name: Twin Comet
description: Every 2nd turn, draw 2 extra cards.
flavor: Seen once every hundred years, on the night the twins were born.

name: Phoenix Feather
description: When an enemy falls, both sisters heal 3 HP.
flavor: Warm to the touch, even in winter.

effects.text: When an enemy falls, both sisters heal 3 HP.

name: Storm Crown
description: The 6th card the party plays each turn grants 1 Energy and draws 1 card.
flavor: Lightning loves a long chain.

description: At the start of each battle, both sisters gain 8 Block and every enemy takes 6 damage.

name: Runic Crown
description: +1 Energy every turn. Draw 1 fewer card each turn.
flavor: Heavy is the head.

name: Eclipse Orb
description: +1 Energy every turn. Enemies deal 10% more damage.
flavor: Darkness answers to whoever holds it, and so do the monsters.

name: Crimson Chalice
description: +1 Energy every turn. Both sisters lose 8 Max HP.
flavor: It fills itself with what you can spare.

flavor: Two rings of light, one above each sister.
